# Symbols and sources

New-san: Paukatong et al., DOI 10.1002/jrs.70113, equations (1)–(13), SI (S1)–(S18).

$R$: Raman tensor in crystal Cartesian coordinates. (relative tensor units).
$d$: Common off-diagonal coefficient of the cubic tensors. (relative tensor units).
$(h,k,\ell)$: Miller indices of the selected surface. (dimensionless).
$[u,v,w]$: Direct-lattice direction used for the in-plane X reference. (dimensionless).
$X,Y,Z$: Measurement unit axes expressed in crystal coordinates. (dimensionless).
$T$: Matrix with X, Y and Z as columns. (dimensionless).
$L$: Direct-lattice vectors as columns; all lengths use one common unit. (selected length unit).
$g$: Reciprocal-lattice surface normal; the common 2π factor cancels on normalization. (inverse length).
$\theta$: Linear-polarization scan angle. (radians; controls use degrees).
$\alpha$: Detection-state scan angle in σ⁺α; fixed at 0 or π/2 for VV or VH. (radians).
$\beta,\beta^{\prime}$: Relative Jones-state phases in New-san equation (11). (radians).
$\hat e_i,\hat e_s^*$: Incident polarization column and conjugated detection row. (normalized).
$I$: Relative intensity. A plotted normalization does not change the raw CSV. (relative intensity units).
